milestones.name: FIRST SIGNAL
milestones.description: Survived your first day on the Right Side.
milestones.loreQuote: A faint heartbeat cuts through the dimensional noise.

milestones.name: THE SIGNAL RETURNS
milestones.loreQuote: The frequencies stabilize. The Other Side takes notice.

milestones.name: HOLD THE LINE
milestones.loreQuote: One full cycle held against the decay. Resonance shields active.

milestones.name: NO TURNING BACK
milestones.loreQuote: Two unbroken weeks. The Other Side is losing ground.

milestones.name: FORTIFIED
milestones.loreQuote: A month in the dark, and you shine brighter than the void.

milestones.name: UNBREAKABLE
milestones.loreQuote: Sixty rotations. Even the dark void recognizes your existence.

milestones.name: BEYOND THE GATE
milestones.loreQuote: The Other Side remembers you. You are no longer surviving; you are reclaiming.

worldEvents.title: SIGNAL SURGE
worldEvents.description: Intense dimensional interference detected on high-frequency monitoring bands. Concentrated thought stabilizes the carrier wave.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: Something is interfering with the signal. Concentration strengthens the boundary.

worldEvents.title: STATIC STORM
worldEvents.description: Atmospheric ionization is scrambling cognitive telemetry. Mental clarity is required to pierce the electromagnetic haze.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: The signal is breaking apart. Thought is the only thing cutting through.

worldEvents.title: IRON WAKE
worldEvents.description: Sub-surface seismic tremors indicate entity mobilization beneath the boundary. Somatic rigor channels defensive kinetic energy.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: Something beneath the boundary has started moving.

worldEvents.title: STILL SIGNAL
worldEvents.description: An eerie silence has fallen across all broadcast frequencies. Centered intention purges corrupted residual signals.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: The noise stopped. For a moment, everything is still.

worldEvents.title: OPEN CHANNEL
worldEvents.description: A harmonic carrier wave has locked onto a distant human transmission. Cooperative resonance reinforces our outpost.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: The signal has found another human frequency.

worldEvents.title: BREACH WARNING
worldEvents.description: Massive dimensional strain detected across multiple sectors. Execute immediate containment protocols across any discipline.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: The boundary is weakening. All hands to stations.

worldEvents.title: THE LONG NIGHT
worldEvents.description: A rare total eclipse of the carrier frequency. The Void presses directly against the perimeter until morning breaks.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: Darkness settles across the threshold. Keep the beacon alive.

worldEvents.title: MEMORY ECHO
worldEvents.description: A resonant feedback loop has surfaced from past survivor missions. Rekindling familiar routines fortifies the anchor.
worldEvents.loreSnippet: Something remembers what you completed before.
